verdict.rationale: Docs confirm approval-policy configuration (docs-7, docs-20, docs-39) and an audit-trail API endpoint (docs-38), but the only documented audit-trail endpoint is scoped to vendor objects, not expense/card transactions specifically, and there's no evidence of a full edit/approval/policy-check history log for S&E expenses suitable for external audit review.
